paras: On Monday [[morning|morning]], Mei and her [[friend|friend]] arrive early at the [[office|office]]. The weather is bright and cool.
They have a short [[meeting|meeting]] about their [[job|jobs]]. Instead of sitting at a table, they decide to [[walk|walk]] around the nearby park.
Fresh air helps them speak openly. They return with two clear tasks and enough energy to begin the day.
zh: 星期一早晨，梅和她的朋友早早来到办公室。天气晴朗而凉爽。
他们要开一个关于工作的短会。他们没有坐在桌边，而是决定绕着附近的公园走一走。
新鲜空气让他们更坦率地交流。他们带着两项明确的任务回到办公室，精力充沛地开始一天。

q.s: The meeting happens in the morning.
They sit at a table for the meeting.
q.why: They walk around the park instead.

q.s: The park is one kilometre from the office.
